description: This Kotlin source file defines a media playback service (`MusicService`) for an Android application, providing functionalities for playing, pausing, stopping, and managing media sessions and notifications related to music playback. It includes the core logic for media control, notification updates, and media session handling.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: An Android service that manages music playback, media session, and notifications. It interacts with media controls and handles lifecycle events for media playback.

classes.name: MusicServiceBinder
classes.description: Binder class providing media control functions such as play, pause, stop, and initialize media player, along with notification and media session management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and sets up the binder.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intent actions to control playback or stop the service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder instance for communication with clients.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops playback when service is destroyed.

methods.name: stopPlaying
methods.description: Stops media playback, resets media state, and optionally releases resources.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Sets up the media player with a given attachment and prepares it for playback.

methods.name: startPlaying
methods.description: Starts media playback if conditions are met.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the media.
